title: Product heat map
description: A persistent decomposition of a product -- surfaces -> panels -> controls -- where each node carries live test evidence (traversals, bugsFound, dryStreak, heat). Readable without any tool. Judgment lives in the heat-map-system-testing skill; update-map.mjs does the counting. validate-map.mjs is authoritative: it reports fields not declared here (additionalProperties: false) as warnings, not errors, so hand-added fields in older maps still load.

builtFrom.description: Git ref / build id the map was walked against (resumability anchor).

mappedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the initial walk. Stamped by tooling.

lastUpdated.description: ISO timestamp of the last fold. Stamped by tooling.

converged.description: True when every leaf is cold. Computed by update-map.mjs. Evidence for the dry declaration, not the declaration itself.

qualities.description: Quality priorities from the project's quality strategy that this map tracks (e.g. 'security', 'accessibility', 'data-integrity'). Node 'qualities' must be drawn from this list.

charterIdeas.description: Open risk areas and charter ideas not yet run: hunter 'flows to test next', problem areas, review concerns. Remove an idea once chartered or judged low-risk.

targets.description: Node ids the idea would exercise.

source.description: Where the idea came from (hunt report, review, user report, change).

folded.description: Ledger of evidence refs already folded (bug ids, hunt report ids). update-map.mjs refuses to fold a ref twice.

nodes.description: Top-level surfaces. Each may nest panels and controls via children.

node.description: A newly added node may omit traversals, bugsFound, dryStreak and heat; update-map.mjs fills them in on its next run, and validate-map.mjs requires them once a fold has run.

label.description: What a user sees or types: the UI label, route, command, flag or endpoint.

kind.description: surface = an entry point a user reaches (window, page/route, command, endpoint group); panel = a region or sub-area within it; control = one thing a user acts on (button, field, menu item, flag, argument, endpoint).

affordance.description: For controls: the kind of affordance (button, menu, dropdown, tab, input, toggle, drag-handle, link, flag, argument, endpoint, ...).

dimensions.description: SFDIPOT product elements in play beyond 'it exists and does its basic job' (e.g. an input carries 'data'; a mode toggle carries 'operations'+'time'; anything that persists or calls a backend carries 'interfaces'). An un-probed dimension keeps a leaf from going cold (Heat table in SKILL.md).

qualities.description: Quality priorities (from top-level 'qualities') that are a live risk at this node. An un-probed quality keeps a leaf from going cold (Heat table in SKILL.md).

probed.description: Dimensions and qualities a charter has actually exercised here since the last change. Maintained by update-map.mjs from fold entries.

traversals.description: How many charters have exercised this node. Folds name leaves, so parent counters stay 0.

bugsFound.description: Cumulative new bugs attributed to this node, from hunts or any other source.

dryStreak.description: Consecutive walks with no new bug here since the last bug or change.

heat.description: Computed by update-map.mjs from the Heat table in the heat-map-system-testing SKILL.md; a leaf's heatOverride wins, and a parent takes its hottest leaf.

heatOverride.description: Leaves only. The driver's judgment when evidence-based heat is wrong (e.g. a clean but fragile area stays warm). update-map.mjs honours it until new bugs or a change clear it; delete it sooner when its reason lapses.

notes.description: Free text: heat overrides and why, parked known bugs, attribution uncertainty, why an unwalked area is judged low-risk, what could not be reached.

children.description: Nested panels/controls. A node with no children is a leaf; heat and convergence are computed over leaves.
